description: Tasks template for the scoped Java 25 runtime upgrade.

tasks.description: Upgrade the Java runtime from 21 to 25 LTS. Addresses assessment issue: Java Version is not the latest LTS (azure-java-version-02000).
tasks.reason: The assessment identifies Java 21 as behind the latest available LTS, Java 25.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the project runtime/build target from Java 21 to Java 25 LTS. Keep Spring Boot 4.1.2 and preserve existing application behavior. Limit changes to those required for the Java runtime upgrade; do not address unrelated cloud-readiness or security findings. Verify the Maven build and existing unit tests using Java 25.
